clips.title: The story
paras: The Scarlet Watchtower is a ruined scout outpost nestled in the southern hills of Tirisfal Glades. Held by the zealous Scarlet Crusade, it provides a direct vantage over aerial traffic entering and leaving the Undercity. Its close proximity to the Forsaken capital's rear sewer entrance makes it a constant thorn in the side of the local undead defenders.

Perched above the southern ridge of Tirisfal Glades, the Scarlet Watchtower serves as an audacious observation post for the Scarlet Crusade. Standing mere paces away from the sewer back entrance of the Undercity, the ruined tower allows crusader scouts to monitor incoming and outgoing flight routes and surface movements into Queen Sylvanas's capital. Commanded by Captain Perrine, the zealots stationed here dare to gaze directly into the heart of Forsaken territory, seeking any opportunity to gather intelligence or strike at the undead they consider abominations.
